name: readme
description: A README file in a repository, read as low-trust documented claims. Its key is the repository's name, ':' and the file's path in the repository, such as orders:README.md.

name: document
description: A Markdown or AsciiDoc document in a repository that is neither a README nor a decision record: one in a doc, docs, documentation or architecture folder, or named ARCHITECTURE. Read as low-trust documented claims. Its key is the repository's name, ':' and the file's path in the repository, such as orders:docs/architecture/overview.md.

name: decision
description: An architecture decision record (ADR) in a repository. Its key is the repository's name, ':' and the file's path in the repository, such as orders:docs/adr/0001-use-kafka.md.

name: claim
description: Something the subject document says, one paragraph, list item, table row or quote in its Markdown or AsciiDoc as written. A documented claim, not checked against the code.

section.description: The heading the claim is under, if any.

name: diagram
description: A diagram the subject document draws: the source of a code block in a diagram language, or of a plain one drawn as boxes, as written. A documented claim, not checked against the code.

section.description: The heading the diagram is under, if any.

language.description: The diagram's language, such as mermaid or plantuml, or text for one drawn with box characters.

name: title
description: The subject's title, as written, without a leading number.

name: decision-number
description: The number of the subject decision record, from its file name or else its title, such as 12 for 0012-use-kafka.md.

name: decision-status
description: The status the subject decision record states, as written, such as Accepted, proposed or Superseded by ADR-0005.

name: decision-date
description: The date the subject decision record states, as written, such as 2024-03-01.

name: decision-context
description: The context or problem statement of the subject decision record: the Markdown of its Context (or Context and Problem Statement) section.

name: decision-outcome
description: What the subject decision record decided, and why where it says: the Markdown of its Decision (or Decision Outcome) section.

name: decision-consequences
description: The consequences the subject decision record states: the Markdown of one of its Consequences sections.
